notes.note: Fix round 3: reviewed the ResponsiveDialogSurface dependency delta against this document scope. Tab recovery now applies only to panel/outside focus; DOM-external portal keydowns are ignored and internal native tab order is preserved. Existing shared focus-owner, composition, styling and boundary guidance remains accurate; no prose change needed. Component coverage and 24 browser tests passed, including production approval inspection and add-connection traversal at 390px/1280px. Test-only harness changes introduce no public contract. Fault and restored evidence are recorded in PR #3673.
